messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, thank you for asking. I’m actually reaching out because I’m going through a bit of a tough time financially right now, and I need some help with my recent orders. I’m feeling pretty overwhelmed, to be honest. I’d like to cancel any orders that haven’t arrived yet, and for the ones that have already been delivered, I’d like to return everything if possible. I can’t quite remember all the things I ordered, so could you help me by listing them out? I just want to make sure I don’t miss anything.

I’m sorry you’re dealing with that—I'm here to help.  

To get started, I first need to authenticate your account so I can look up your orders and list what you purchased. Please share **one** of the following:

1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I have that, I’ll pull up your orders and tell you:
- which ones are **not yet arrived** (so we can cancel those), and  
- which ones are **already delivered** (so we can return everything that’s eligible).

Thank you, I really appreciate your understanding. My name is Amelia Silva, and my ZIP code is 19103. I hope that’s enough to pull up my account. I just want to make sure I handle everything properly, so I’m really grateful for your help right now.
Error: User not found

Thanks, Amelia. I tried looking up your account using **Amelia Silva + ZIP 19103**, but I couldn’t find a matching user.

Could you please share **either**:
1) the **email address** on your account, **or**
2) your **correct ZIP code** (if 19103 isn’t quite right), plus confirm your full name is exactly **Amelia Silva**?

Once I can locate your account, I’ll list your orders (not-yet-arrived vs delivered) so you can decide what to cancel/return.

Oh, sorry about that! I might have mixed things up—my mind is just all over the place lately. The email I use for my orders is silva7872@example.com. My full name is Amelia Silva, yes. Thank you for being patient with me.
Error: User not found

I’m sorry—when I tried looking up your account, it still didn’t find a match using **silva7872@example.com**.

To proceed, could you please confirm one of the following?

1) Is **silva7872@example.com** definitely the exact email you used at checkout (spelling, any dots/underscores)?  
2) If you might have used a different email, share that email instead.  
3) Or, if email is uncertain, share your **correct ZIP code** (and confirm your name is **Amelia Silva**).

Once I can locate your account, I’ll list all your orders and clearly separate **not-yet-arrived (cancel eligible)** vs **delivered (return eligible)**.

Oh, you know what, I think I might have used my other email for some orders. It’s amelia.silva7872@example.com. Sorry for the confusion—I have two emails and sometimes I forget which one I used! My name is definitely Amelia Silva, and I’m in Philadelphia. Thank you so much for sticking with me through this.
